observations: Photo 0 shows a car engine bay/engine assembly laid out on the ground, with many hoses, wiring, and intake/exhaust components visible.
There is a visible engine cover/label area, but no clearly readable brand/model text on the engine itself in this photo.
The photo does not show the vehicle chassis/plate, VIN, or any paperwork.
No clear evidence of engine running condition (no smoke, no temperature, no dashboard/OBD readout).

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows an engine assembly but no readable Lexus/LX460 identification, VIN, or Japan-origin documentation.

risks.risk: Engine may not be the claimed Lexus LX460 (wrong engine model/variant).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine identification plate/stamping (engine code) and/or the VIN/part number label on the engine block, plus a photo of the transmission mating area showing the correct pairing.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unknown used engine (worst case: not confirmed to be LX460 and not confirmed working).

risks.risk: Unknown working condition (may be defective, incomplete, or missing parts).
risks.proof: Video clip of a cold start (or at least cranking) and a short OBD scan/diagnostic printout showing no critical faults.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working / needs overhaul until proven otherwise.

risks.risk: Possible damage from removal/transport (bent pipes, broken sensors/connectors, oil leaks).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of common failure points: wiring harness connectors, sensor ports, intake/exhaust manifolds, and any visible cracks/loose mounts.
risks.if_unproven: Priced with allowance for missing/broken parts (worst case: repair needed).

risks.risk: Completeness risk (not all components included for a full swap).
risks.proof: A full checklist photo: alternator, starter, AC compressor, power steering pump, radiator hoses, sensors, ECU/ignition modules (if applicable), and all brackets.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete until all swap-critical parts are shown.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the engine code/ID stamping on the block (and any label/plate).
Photo of the transmission/engine mating area and part numbers (to confirm correct pairing).
Video of engine cranking/start (or running) plus an OBD scan showing fault codes.
Photos showing completeness: all sensors, ECU/ignition components, alternator/starter, and any accessories included.
response.reason: The photo shows an engine assembly, but there is no readable identification to confirm it is a Lexus LX460 Japan engine, and there is no evidence of working condition. Without engine code/ID and proof of functionality, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
